name: texteditor-tauri
description: Tauri editor client for the writing-assistant engine (ADR-0013/0014/0017). Dumb client: the UI talks to the engine over the OpenAPI contract; the Rust core bundles + spawns the engine sidecar (ADR-0021 §1) and hosts native file dialogs (E7). No Node at runtime (Bun/Node build-time only).
